summary: Iteration 132: Cross-client Blueprint Pattern Discovery testing complete. All 17 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend UI verified working with correct data-testids. Fixed API endpoint mismatch in frontend (was calling /blueprints/patterns instead of /blueprint-patterns).

integration_issues.issue: FIXED: Frontend was calling wrong API endpoints (/api/blueprints/patterns and /api/blueprints/suggest-from-pattern instead of /api/blueprint-patterns and /api/blueprint-patterns/suggest)

issues: Console warnings about chart dimensions (-1 width/height) - cosmetic only, charts still render

seed_data_creation: Test data created with TEST_ prefix for blueprints
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 132 added Cross-client Blueprint Pattern Discovery: (1) GET /api/blueprint-patterns scans resolved tickets for recurring patterns using bigram clustering, (2) POST /api/blueprint-patterns/suggest uses Claude Sonnet 4.5 to draft blueprints from patterns, (3) POST /api/blueprints/{bp_id}/push-to-clients pushes blueprints to multiple clients. Frontend has 2 tabs on /blueprints page: Library (existing) and Pattern Discovery. Pattern cards show name_guess, tokens, ticket_count, client_count, Generate Blueprint button. The suggest dialog shows AI-drafted blueprint with push toggles. Note: Pattern detection requires min 2-3 resolved tickets with matching title bigrams. Current test data has only 9 resolved tickets with 1 pattern (voice_printer with 2 tickets).

get_blueprint_patterns.details: GET /api/blueprint-patterns returns correct structure with patterns array, total_scanned, window. Respects min_tickets and limit query params.

suggest_from_pattern.details: POST /api/blueprint-patterns/suggest accepts tokens and sample_ticket_ids, calls Claude Sonnet 4.5, returns draft blueprint with fields/checklist and source_tickets.

push_to_clients.details: POST /api/blueprints/{bp_id}/push-to-clients updates multiple clients' blueprint_ids arrays. make_default flag sets default_blueprint_id. Handles invalid client IDs gracefully.

frontend_tabs.details: Blueprints page has Library and Pattern Discovery tabs with correct data-testids.

frontend_patterns_panel.details: Pattern Discovery tab shows scanned count, min_tickets input, Rescan button, and pattern cards (when patterns exist).

frontend_suggest_dialog.details: Generate Blueprint button opens suggest dialog with loading state, draft editor, push toggles, and save button.
